propositions: A PreToolUse hook must trigger on grep-family commands (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) via plain string matching in the command and emit a non-blocking JSON reminder to additionalContext

The reminder message must be 2–3 lines, name find_referencing_symbols as the preferred path, and explain the legitimate cases for grep (string literals, line numbers) so agents are informed rather than overridden
The hook must be non-blocking (omit permissionDecision, never exit 2) and non-destructive (grep output unchanged, no permission prompt suppressed)

The hook implementation lives in scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py (tracked, testable) and merges into .claude/settings.json without overwriting the existing env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH entry from story C

An automated test must verify the hook fires on grep/rg commands and not on non-grep commands, executes against the documented PreToolUse stdin envelope, and asserts JSON structure (additionalContext present, permissionDecision absent)
